content.comment_body: Hello, I previously received helpful advice here, thank you. Currently, I'm working to open pages created in [product_name], which have already been transferred to [product_name] (both the program and pages). However, these pages do not appear in the app when connected, nor via direct web access on [product_name]. Could you offer guidance for displaying pages that were created but are not showing in the [product_name] app or over the Internet? Thank you [user_name]
Is this what you mean: you created more than just the first page, but cannot see these additional pages, only the first one? Or do you not see any pages at all?

Hello, There is no screen created by [product_name]. The direct link between PC and [product_name] brings up the basic [product_name] image (see attached file). I'm using an Android emulator (Blue Stacks) to simulate a tablet screen on the PC, and using the connected [product_name] app web also does not display the created screens. In both cases, the PC is connected to [product_name], but none of the created screens show up (program and screens have been transferred). Thanks for your assistance with this part of configuring [product_name] functions. Thank you [user_name]

It seems there was some confusion. You mentioned [product_name], which refers to [product_name] Web Editor, for creating custom web pages for the extended web server. Your screenshots only show the simple web server. You'll need to clarify whether you're using the simple or extended web server, as they require different approaches. The extended web server is available only on newer models (with specific [article_no]).

Hi, I'm working directly with the [product_name] model [article_no], using a memory card in the correct slot. The problem is that the created pages are not being transferred to [product_name]. [user_name]
Did you select the option 'to customized site'?
Please upload your [product_name] project. I can then test it with [product_name] and my PC.
Hello, Attached is the [product_name] project containing four pages (I removed equipment photos to reduce file size); all project variables are included. Thank you for your help. [user_name]
Please note, this [product_name] project file is missing the navigation setting. Thank you [user_name]

When I load your original [product_name] project into [product_name], only the 'Home Page' is visible and the other pages do not show. This is because the pages were not linked to the navigation. I updated your project and connected the pages to the navigation. The edited project is attached as version [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing problems where multiple web pages created with [product_name] Web Editor and transferred to the [product_name] hardware don't appear in the [product_name] app or via direct web access; only the default 'Home Page' is seen. The issue is due to missing configuration, specifically that additional pages need to be linked to the navigation within the editor for them to be accessible. This navigation linking requirement is often overlooked and leads to confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that after transferring all created pages with [product_name] Web Editor, these pages should be viewable and navigable in the [product_name] app and via direct web access to the module.
